connect.title: Connect Readers
connect.modal_desc: Use network catalog protocols to access your digital library from e-ink readers (PocketBook, KOReader), mobile reading apps, and third-party tools.
connect.opds_v1_desc: Standard catalog feed for PocketBook, KOReader, FBReader, Moon+ Reader, AlReaderX and classic e-readers.
connect.opds_v2_desc: Next-gen JSON-LD catalog for modern reading applications (Thorium Reader, Cantook, Foliate).
connect.api_desc: Interactive Swagger API documentation for developers and automation scripts.
connect.guide_pocketbook_desc: Open Browser app or Network Libraries → Add catalog → Enter name 'Boyan' and OPDS v1.2 feed URL.
connect.guide_koreader_desc: Menu 'Search & catalogs' → 'OPDS catalogs' → '+ Add catalog' → Enter name and OPDS v1.2 feed URL.
connect.guide_moonreader_desc: Net Library tab → 'Add new catalog' → Enter OPDS v1.2 feed URL.

storage.title: Storage Management
storage.subtitle: Folder scans, background task queues, and library imports
storage.watch_dir_hint: Monitored folder for incoming books. Files are processed, validated, and unpacked automatically.
storage.library_dir_hint: Root directory containing all curated books organized in the library.
storage.calibre_subtitle: Direct import of books and metadata from metadata.db
storage.calibre_copy_files: Copy book files to Boyan library storage
storage.calibre_task_started: Calibre import task started. Real-time progress is displayed in the Background Tasks section below.
storage.calibre_path_hint: Specify the absolute path to the Calibre directory. The Boyan server process must have read access and traverse rights to all parent directories.
storage.calibre_perm_alert_desc: The server process cannot read metadata.db or traverse parent directories. This is typically caused by systemd sandbox isolation (ProtectHome) or Linux file permissions.
storage.calibre_perm_opt_systemd_title: Most common cause: systemd blocks access to /home (ProtectHome=true)
storage.calibre_perm_opt_systemd_desc: By default, boyan.service enables ProtectHome=true which makes /home completely inaccessible. Change to ProtectHome=read-only:
storage.calibre_perm_opt1_title: File permissions: Add user boyan to the owner's group and grant group read access
storage.calibre_perm_opt2_title: Access Control Lists: Use POSIX ACLs (without changing user groups)
storage.calibre_perm_opt3_title: If Boyan is running in Docker
storage.calibre_perm_opt3_desc: Mount the host directory in docker-compose.yml (e.g., volumes: - /home/user/library:/calibre:ro), and enter /calibre in the path field.
